scope: Targeted follow-up, not exhaustive search; original eight-cohort and four-contrast snapshots stay frozen.

contrasts: P1 Nanos3-Cre versus noCre, 4/4, flox/- controls
P3 Dhh-Cre versus noCre, 4/4, flox/flox controls
GSE180204.role: Early developmental perturbation comparisons, not demonstrated meiotic-arrest tissue at collection
GSE180204.batch_plan: Use author-supplied batch; adjust P1 for B1/B2, P3 single batch. Also examine P1 B2-only 3/3 as prespecified batch sensitivity; no automatic sample removal.
GSE180204.DE_plan: Preserve original Ensembl gene counts, independent filterByExpr, TMM, voom, limma; FDR<0.05 and abs(log2FC)>1; KO minus explicitly stated noCre control. 16 leave-one-out refits; ranges are not confidence intervals.
GSE180204.annotation_review_before_DE: Current symbol mapping covers 94.7-97.7% of count mass. An initial symbol-only import stopped at its coverage guard before any DE fit. Revised import preserves all original gene-ID counts; mapping is only used after DE for one-to-one cross-study comparisons, and no threshold was relaxed.
GSE180204.post_primary_diagnostic: After observing significance disagreement with author DESeq2 tables, add robust edgeR quasi-likelihood fits with the same tested genes/design; explicitly sensitivity-only, never replace limma or select the method with more discoveries.
GSE180204.comparison_plan: Intersect with the frozen original 8099-gene universe and original eight-cohort effects, no reselection based on agreement; no age-by-Cre causal interpretation.

GSE181132.role: Unit and sample-identity audit only; processed files are transcript FPKM, not integer gene counts. No rounding or primary-count admission.
